games.name: Build and Conquer [V0.1]
games.desc:
The game is still in its BETA version. Expect bugs and constant updates.

Start with an empty plot and build a country that can stand on its own.

Create neighbourhoods, roads, farms, shops, factories, power plants, water networks, and large cities. Manage money, workers, population, resources, happiness, power, research, production, and city expansion as your country grows.

Research new technology, manufacture vehicles and missiles, deploy troops through tunnels to the mainland, form alliances, defend your cities, and fight other nations for control of strategic areas.

Build carefully. A strong economy wins wars, but a strong military protects everything you built.
